body: ffmpeg gdigrab -i title=<window> returns a stale frame for the Bevy (GPU swapchain) window: 17 s of identical frames while BRP screenshots showed the scene moving

capture = gdigrab -i desktop on the game window's client rect after SetWindowPos(HWND_TOPMOST) (ctypes, HWND argtypes required: untyped -1 gave ERROR_INVALID_WINDOW_HANDLE); alternatives rejected: gdigrab title= (stale), gfxcapture (absent in ffmpeg 8.0 essentials), BRP screenshot sequence (>=0.15 s spacing, ~6 fps)
